caption:
A two-to-one reward-to-risk ratio does not guarantee a profitable strategy.

Reward-to-risk compares a planned potential gain with a planned potential loss. It does not tell you how often a setup wins, and real fills can differ because of costs or slippage. Evaluate a method over a meaningful sample, include expenses, and avoid treating one ratio as proof of an edge.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
